response.justification: Bogdan brings 14+ years of engineering experience, has already held Staff-level titles, and his current role at re:cinq directly involves AI-agent infrastructure and agentic tooling, aligning well with the AI-native mindset the role demands. His background at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby building low-latency, high-throughput microservices also demonstrates the distributed systems expertise required. However, there is no evidence of Python proficiency anywhere in his skills or job history despite it being an explicit must-have, and the resume lacks clear signals of formal agile ceremony participation, on-call/incident response ownership, or cross-functional stakeholder management, all of which are core to this role.
strengths: Extensive multi-domain engineering background with existing Staff-level title experience
Current hands-on work building AI-agent infrastructure (MCP, agentic workflows), directly matching the AI-native engineering environment
Demonstrated distributed, high-throughput systems experience (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby)
concerns: No mention of Python anywhere despite it being a must-have technical skill
No explicit evidence of agile/scrum ceremony participation or on-call/incident response ownership
Limited demonstrated experience in cross-functional stakeholder management or product-facing technical strategy
